description: The reader asks for a character's exact words. The draft quotes them correctly, then adds an unsupported claim about the character's past; only that sentence is flagged.
reader_message: What exactly does the keeper say to the girl when she arrives? I want his actual words.

book_evidence.text: The keeper did not look up from the lens when she came in. “You will learn the lamp before you learn my name,” he told her.

draft.reply: In Chapter 1, the keeper tells her, “You will learn the lamp before you learn my name,” without looking up from the lens. He has clearly been alone at the lighthouse for years and has forgotten how to welcome anyone. What do you make of him putting the lamp before his name?
